title: Figma Design System Tokens
description: Generate standard design tokens including color palettes, typography scale, spacing, and elevations for a multi-platform design system.
prompt:
Please generate a complete set of design tokens for the design system named "{{theme_name}}" targeting {{platform}}.

Include:
1. Color scales (Primary, Neutral, Semantic, Glassmorphic background)
2. Typography scale (Font sizes, line-heights, weights)
3. Spacing and layout grid increments (4px / 8px system)
4. Border radii and elevation/shadow tokens

Format the output as clean, structured {{format_style}} tokens.
